name: @activepieces/piece-truelayer
description: Connect with TrueLayer to leverage secure open banking services. This integration allows seamless interaction with TrueLayer's API to manage various financial processes.

create-payout.name: create-payout
create-payout.description: Pay out from one of your merchant accounts.

aiMetadata.description: Initiate a payout (transfer of funds) from one of your TrueLayer merchant accounts to a beneficiary. This moves money and is not idempotent on its own, so supply the required idempotency key so retries do not duplicate the payout. To check a payout afterward use Get Payout, and to authorize it use Start authorization flow.
Retrieve the details and current status of a single payout by its ID. Use to check the outcome or state of a payout you previously created; read-only and safe to repeat.

start-payout-authorization-flow.name: start-payout-authorization-flow
start-payout-authorization-flow.description: Start the authorization flow for a payout. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payout you are trying to fetch.

aiMetadata.description: Begin the authorization flow for an existing payout identified by its ID, transitioning it toward execution. Use after creating a payout that requires authorization; this advances payout state and is not idempotent. To create the payout first, use Create Payout.

submit-payments-provider-return-paramete.name: submit-payments-provider-return-parameters
submit-payments-provider-return-paramete.description: Submit direct return query and fragment parameters returned from the provider.

aiMetadata.description: Forward the query and fragment parameters TrueLayer returned to your direct redirect URI back to TrueLayer to continue the payment/payout authorization flow. Use only when handling a provider redirect return; pass an idempotency key to make retries safe. Not a read or status-check operation.

create-mandate.name: create-mandate
create-mandate.description: Create a new mandate. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new TrueLayer payment mandate (a recurring-payment authorization) using a backend bearer token. Use when setting up variable recurring payments before any individual payment is taken. This writes a new resource each call; supply the optional idempotency key to prevent duplicate mandates on retry.

list-mandate.name: list-mandate
list-mandate.description: List all the mandates associated with the client. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

user_id.description: Optional ID of the user whose mandates you want to list.

limit.description: Optional limit on the number of mandates to return.

aiMetadata.description: List the variable recurring payment (VRP) mandates belonging to your client, optionally filtered by user ID and paged via cursor. Use to discover mandate IDs or audit a user's mandates; read-only and safe to repeat.

get-mandate.name: get-mandate
get-mandate.description: Returns a mandate with the stated ID. This endpoint can be called either by the regular `backend token` or the `mandate token` for that mandate.

id.description: The ID of the mandate to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a single TrueLayer mandate by its ID, including its current status and details. Use when you have a known mandate ID and need to inspect or poll its state. Read-only and safe to repeat; callable with either a backend bearer token or that mandate's mandate token.

start-mandate-authorization-flow.name: start-mandate-authorization-flow
start-mandate-authorization-flow.description: Start the authorization flow for a mandate. This API can be called using either the mandate_token associated with the mandate or a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the mandate to start the authorization flow for.

aiMetadata.description: Begin the authorization flow for an existing mandate identified by its ID so the user can authorize the recurring payment arrangement. Use after the mandate is created; this advances mandate state and is not idempotent. Follow with Submit consent if the flow requires it.

submit-consent-mandate.name: submit-consent-mandate
submit-consent-mandate.description: Submit the consent given by the user. This API can be called using either the mandate_token associated with the mandate or a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the mandate for which consent is being submitted.

aiMetadata.description: Submit the user's consent action within a mandate authorization flow, identified by the mandate ID. Use after Start Authorization Flow when the flow requires a consent step; this advances mandate state and is not idempotent.

submit-mandate-provider-selection.name: submit-mandate-provider-selection
submit-mandate-provider-selection.description: Submit the provider details selected by the PSU. This API can be called using either the mandate_token associated with the mandate or a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the mandate for which provider selection is being submitted.

aiMetadata.description: Advance a mandate's authorization flow by submitting the bank provider the user selected. Use during an interactive mandate setup when the flow requires a provider-selection step. This mutates the flow state and is not safe to repeat; it is the mandate counterpart to the payment provider-selection action.

revoke-mandate.name: revoke-mandate
revoke-mandate.description: Revoke a mandate. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the mandate to revoke.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently revoke a mandate so no further payments can be taken under it, using a backend bearer token. Use to cancel a recurring-payment authorization. This is a destructive state change on the mandate; re-running after success has no further effect but should be treated as one-time.

confirm-mandate-funds.name: confirm-mandate-funds
confirm-mandate-funds.description: Confirm that the PSU has the given funds. This API can be called using the mandate_token associated with the mandate or using a backend bearer token.

id.description: ID of the Mandate to be confirmed.

amount_in_minor.description: A "cent" value representing the amount. For example, 100 == 1 GBP.

aiMetadata.description: Check whether the payment service user behind a mandate has sufficient funds for a given amount and currency, identified by the mandate ID. This is a read-only funds availability check that does not move money and is safe to repeat.

get-constraints.name: get-constraints
get-constraints.description: Retrieve the constraints defined on the mandate, as well as the current utilization of those constraints within the periods.

id.description: The ID of the mandate to retrieve the constraints for.

aiMetadata.description: Look up the spending constraints set on a mandate and how much has already been used within each period. Use to check remaining headroom or limits before initiating a payment under the mandate. Read-only and safe to repeat.

list-operating-accounts.name: list-operating-accounts
list-operating-accounts.description: List all your TrueLayer merchant accounts. There might be more than one account per currency.

aiMetadata.description: List all merchant accounts belonging to your TrueLayer client, including their currencies and balances. Use to discover available merchant account IDs before creating payouts or configuring sweeping; read-only and safe to repeat. To fetch one account by ID instead, use Get Merchant Account.

get-operating-account.name: get-operating-account
get-operating-account.description: Get the details of a single merchant account.

id.description: The ID of the merchant account to be retrieved.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the details of a single merchant account by its ID, including currency, balance, and account identifiers. Use when you already have the account ID; read-only and safe to repeat. To discover account IDs first, use List Merchant Accounts.

merchant-account-get-transactions.name: merchant-account-get-transactions
merchant-account-get-transactions.description: Get the transactions of a single merchant account. If pagination is missing, add a header `tl-enable-pagination: true` to enable pagination.

id.description: The ID of the merchant account to return the transactions for.

from.description: Timestamp for the start of the range to query (inclusive). Uses the ISO-8601 format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HHMM.

to.description: Timestamp for the end of the range to query (inclusive). Uses the ISO-8601 format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS±HHMM.

cursor.description: Cursor used for pagination purposes, returned as `next_cursor` in the response payload of the initial request. Not required for the first page.

type.description: Filters transactions by payments or payouts. If omitted, both are returned.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the transaction history for one merchant account over a required ISO-8601 from/to date range, optionally filtered by type (payments or payouts) and paged via cursor. Use to reconcile activity on a specific account; read-only and safe to repeat. To get account metadata instead, use Get Merchant Account.

merchant-account-setup-sweeping.name: merchant-account-setup-sweeping
merchant-account-setup-sweeping.description: Set the automatic sweeping settings for a merchant account. At regular intervals, any available balance in excess of the configured `max_amount_in_minor` is withdrawn to a pre-configured IBAN.

id.description: The ID of the merchant account to set or update sweeping settings for.

max_amount_in_minor.description: The amount above which sweeping will occur, expressed in minor units (e.g., 100 means 1 GBP).

frequency.description: The frequency of the sweeping operation (e.g., daily, weekly).

iban.description: The IBAN to which sweeping funds will be transferred.

aiMetadata.description: Configure or update automatic sweeping for a merchant account so balance above a threshold is periodically withdrawn to a fixed IBAN at the chosen frequency. Idempotent: it sets the full sweeping configuration for the account, so repeating with the same values leaves the same settings. To stop sweeping use Disable Sweeping; to read current settings use Get Sweeping Settings.

merchant-account-disable-sweeping.name: merchant-account-disable-sweeping
merchant-account-disable-sweeping.description: Disable automatic sweeping for a merchant account.

id.description: The ID of the merchant account to disable sweeping for.

aiMetadata.description: Turn off automatic sweeping for a merchant account by its ID, deleting the current sweeping configuration. Idempotent in effect: once sweeping is off, repeating leaves it off. To configure or re-enable sweeping use Set Up or Update Sweeping.

merchant-account-get-sweeping.name: merchant-account-get-sweeping
merchant-account-get-sweeping.description: Get the automatic sweeping settings for a merchant account.

id.description: The ID of the merchant account to fetch the sweeping settings for.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the current automatic sweeping configuration (threshold, frequency, destination IBAN) for a merchant account by its ID. Use to check whether and how sweeping is set up; read-only and safe to repeat. To change it use Set Up or Update Sweeping, or Disable Sweeping.

get-merchant-account-payment-sources.name: get-merchant-account-payment-sources
get-merchant-account-payment-sources.description: Get the payment sources from which the merchant account has received payments.

id.description: The ID of the merchant account into which payments were made.

user_id.description: The ID of the user whose payment sources are being retrieved.

aiMetadata.description: List the verified payment sources (payer bank details) from which a given user has previously paid into a merchant account. Use to obtain a payer source for refunds or returning payouts; read-only and safe to repeat. Requires both the merchant account ID and the user ID.

create-payment-link.name: create-payment-link
create-payment-link.description: Create a new payment link. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new hosted payment link that a payer can use to make a payment. This provisions a new resource and is not idempotent on its own, so supply the optional idempotency key so retries do not create duplicate links. To read a link or its payments afterward, use Get Payment Link or Get Payments.

get-payment-link.name: get-payment-link
get-payment-link.description: Retrieves payment link details. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the payment link to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the configuration and status of a single payment link by its ID. Use to inspect a link you created; read-only and safe to repeat. To list the payments collected through it instead, use Get Payments.

get-payment-link-payments.name: get-payment-link-payments
get-payment-link-payments.description: List all the payments associated with the payment link. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the payment link for which payments are being retrieved.

cursor.description: Cursor used for pagination purposes, returned as `next_cursor` in the response payload of the initial request. Not required for the first page of items.

limit.description: Optional limit on the number of payments to return.

aiMetadata.description: List the payments made against a specific payment link, identified by the link ID, with cursor-based pagination. Use to reconcile or review payments collected through a payment link; read-only and safe to repeat. To fetch the link itself use Get Payment Link.

create-payment.name: create-payment
create-payment.description: Create a new payment. This API must be called using a backend bearer token.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: A key that uniquely identifies the request. If the same key is sent in another request, the operation will have the same result as the first request.

SignatureHeader.description: Header containing the signature of the request payload for authentication purposes.

PsuIpAddressHeader.description: Used to collect and record the end-user's IP address. Only considered if the authorization_flow object in the request body is specified.

DeviceUserAgentHeader.description: Used to improve the end-user's authentication experience based on the device type. If omitted, the `User-Agent` header will be used instead. Only considered if the authorization_flow object in the request body is specified.

aiMetadata.description: Initiate a new TrueLayer single payment using a backend bearer token, returning the payment resource and token used to drive its authorization. Use as the first step of taking a payment from a user. This creates a new payment each call; the required idempotency key prevents duplicate charges when retrying.

start-payment-authorization-flow.name: start-payment-authorization-flow
start-payment-authorization-flow.description: Start the authorization flow for a payment. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the payment for which to start the authorization flow.

aiMetadata.description: Begin the authorization flow for an existing payment, returning the first action the user must take (e.g. provider selection or redirect). Use after create-payment to start driving the user through authorization. This mutates the payment's flow state and should be called once per payment, not repeatedly.

submit-provider-selection.name: submit-provider-selection
submit-provider-selection.description: Submit the provider details selected by the PSU. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the payment for which provider selection is being submitted.

aiMetadata.description: Advance a payment's authorization flow by submitting the bank provider the user selected. Use only when the flow has reached a provider-selection step. This mutates flow state and is not safe to repeat; it is the payment counterpart to the mandate provider-selection action.

submit-scheme-selection.name: submit-scheme-selection
submit-scheme-selection.description: Submit the scheme details selected by the PSU. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the payment for which the scheme details are being submitted.

aiMetadata.description: Advance a payment's authorization flow by submitting the payment scheme the user chose. Use only when the flow has reached a scheme-selection step. This mutates flow state and is not safe to repeat; distinct from the provider-selection, consent, and form submission steps of the same flow.

submit-form.name: submit-form
submit-form.description: Submit form details filled by the PSU. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the payment for which the form is being submitted.

aiMetadata.description: Advance a payment's authorization flow by submitting form input the user filled in (e.g. additional bank-required fields). Use only when the flow has reached a form step. This mutates flow state and is not safe to repeat; distinct from provider, scheme, consent, and account-selection steps.

submit-consent.name: submit-consent
submit-consent.description: Submit the consent given by the user. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the payment for which consent is being submitted.

aiMetadata.description: Advance a payment's authorization flow by recording the user's consent. Use only when the flow has reached a consent step. This mutates flow state and is not safe to repeat; it is one of several authorization-flow steps (provider, scheme, form, account selection).

submit-user-account-selection.name: submit-user-account-selection
submit-user-account-selection.description: Submit the user account selection option given by the user. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the payment for which the user account selection is being submitted.

aiMetadata.description: Advance a payment's authorization flow by submitting which of the user's accounts to pay from. Use only when the flow has reached a user-account-selection step. This mutates flow state and is not safe to repeat; distinct from provider, scheme, consent, and form steps.

cancel-payment.name: cancel-payment
cancel-payment.description: Cancel a payment. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the payment to cancel.

aiMetadata.description: Cancel an in-progress payment so it can no longer be authorized or executed. Use to abandon a payment before it completes. This is a state change on the payment and should be treated as one-time; callable with the payment resource token or a backend bearer token.

save-user-account-payment.name: save-user-account-payment
save-user-account-payment.description: Save the account details associated with a payment for subsequent re-use. This API can be called using the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the payment to save the account details for.

aiMetadata.description: Save the payer's account details from a payment so they can be reused for future payments. Use after a successful payment to store the account for repeat use. This writes new stored-account state and is not a read; callable with the payment resource token or a backend bearer token.

get-payment.name: get-payment
get-payment.description: Returns payment details. This API can be called using either the `resource_token` associated with the payment or a backend bearer token.

id.description: The ID of the payment to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve a single payment by its ID, including its current status. Use when you have a known payment ID and need to inspect or poll the payment's state (e.g. waiting for it to settle). Read-only and safe to repeat; callable with either the payment resource token or a backend bearer token.

create-payment-refund.name: create-payment-refund
create-payment-refund.description: Refund a merchant account payment, either fully or partially.

id.description: The payment ID for the payment to be fully or partially refunded.

amount_in_minor.description: The amount to refund, expressed in minor units (e.g., 100 means 1 GBP).

aiMetadata.description: Issue a refund against an existing merchant-account payment, given its payment ID; omit the amount to refund in full or set an amount in minor units for a partial refund. Use to return funds to a payer. This creates a new refund each call and is not safe to repeat without external deduplication.

get-payment-refunds.name: get-payment-refunds
get-payment-refunds.description: Returns all refunds of a payment.

id.description: The ID of the merchant account payment to retrieve all refunds for.

aiMetadata.description: List all refunds issued against a given merchant-account payment. Use to review a payment's refund history or find a refund ID. Read-only and safe to repeat; to fetch one refund by its ID, use the single-refund lookup action instead.

get-payment-refund.name: get-payment-refund
get-payment-refund.description: Returns refund details for a specific payment.

payment_id.description: The ID of the payment for which the refund was made.

refund_id.description: The ID of the refund to retrieve details for.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve details and status of a single refund, identified by both its payment ID and refund ID. Use when you know the specific refund you want to inspect. Read-only and safe to repeat; to list every refund on a payment instead, use the get-all-refunds action.

search-payment-providers.name: search-payment-providers
search-payment-providers.description: Returns a list of payment providers.

aiMetadata.description: Search and list available TrueLayer payment providers (banks) that can be offered to a payer. Use to discover provider options before initiating a payment; read-only and safe to repeat. To fetch one provider by its known ID instead, use Get Payment Provider.

get-payment-provider.name: get-payment-provider
get-payment-provider.description: Returns payment provider details. This API can be called without the need for authentication.

id.description: The ID of the payment provider to retrieve details for.

client_id.description: Optional client ID to retrieve specific provider details.

icon_type.description:
Optional configuration for the type of icon:
      - `default`: Default icon with no background (SVG).
      - `extended`: Extended to a square with an appropriate background color (SVG).
      - `extended_small`: Extended icon with 192x192 px size (JPEG).
      - `extended_medium`: Extended icon with 432x432 px size (JPEG).
      - `extended_large`: Extended icon jpeg with 864x864 px size (JPEG).

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve full details for a single TrueLayer payment provider (bank) by its known provider ID, optionally selecting an icon variant. Use when you already have the provider ID; read-only and safe to repeat. To discover providers by criteria instead, use Search Payment Providers.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

nl.Connect with TrueLayer to leverage secur: Verbind met TrueLayer om veilige open bankdiensten te gebruiken. Deze integratie maakt een naadloze interactie met TrueLayer's API mogelijk om verschillende financiële processen te beheren.
nl.Pay out from one of your merchant accoun: Betaal uit van een van uw handelaarsaccounts.
nl.Start the authorization flow for a payou: Start de autorisatiestroom voor een betaling. Deze API kan aangeroepen worden met behulp van de `resource_token` geassocieerd met de uitbetaling die je probeert op te halen.
nl.Submit direct return query and fragment: Dien query en fragmentparameters van de provider in.
nl.Create a new mandate. This API must be c: Maak een nieuw mandaat. Deze API moet worden aangeroepen met behulp van een backend teken.
nl.List all the mandates associated with th: Laat alle mandaten zien die zijn gekoppeld aan de client. Deze API moet worden aangeroepen met behulp van een backend teken.
nl.Returns a mandate with the stated ID. Th: Retourneert een mandaat met het opgegeven ID. Dit eindpunt kan worden aangeroepen door de standaard `backend token` of de `mandaat`.
nl.Start the authorization flow for a manda: Start de autorisatieflow voor een mandaat. Deze API kan worden aangeroepen met behulp van ofwel het mandate_token of een backend teken.
nl.Submit the consent given by the user. Th: Verzend de toestemming van de gebruiker. Deze API kan worden aangeroepen met behulp van de mandate_token die is gekoppeld aan het mandaat of een backend teken.
nl.Submit the provider details selected by: Dien de providergegevens in die geselecteerd zijn door het PSU. Deze API kan worden aangeroepen met behulp van een mandate_token of een backend teken.
nl.Revoke a mandate. This API must be calle: Intrekken van een mandaat. Deze API moet worden aangeroepen met behulp van een backend token.
nl.Confirm that the PSU has the given funds: Bevestig dat de PSU de gegeven fondsen heeft. Deze API kan worden aangeroepen met behulp van de mandate_token die is gekoppeld aan het mandate_token of met behulp van een backend teken.
nl.Retrieve the constraints defined on the: De beperkingen van het mandaat herstellen en het huidige gebruik van deze beperkingen binnen de periodes.
nl.List all your TrueLayer merchant account: Laat al uw TrueLayer handelaarsaccounts zien. Mogelijk is er meer dan één rekening per valuta.
nl.Get the details of a single merchant acc: Krijg de details van een enkele handelaarsaccount.
nl.Get the transactions of a single merchan: Haal de transacties op van een enkele handelaarsaccount. Als paginering ontbreekt, voeg dan een kop `tl-enable-pagination: true` toe om paginering in te schakelen.
nl.Set the automatic sweeping settings for: Stel de instellingen voor automatisch vegen in voor een handelaarsaccount. Op regelmatige intervallen wordt elk beschikbaar saldo dat groter is dan de geconfigureerde `max_amount_in_minor` teruggetrokken naar een vooraf geconfigureerde IBAN.
nl.Disable automatic sweeping for a merchan: Automatisch vegen voor een handelaarsaccount uitschakelen.
nl.Get the automatic sweeping settings for: Haal de automatisch veeginstellingen op voor een handelaarsaccount.
nl.Get the payment sources from which the m: Krijg de betaalbronnen waar de handelaarsaccount betalingen van heeft ontvangen.
nl.Create a new payment link. This API must: Maak een nieuwe betalingslink. Deze API moet worden aangeroepen met behulp van een backend teken.
nl.Retrieves payment link details. This API: Ophalen van betalingslink details. Deze API moet worden aangeroepen met behulp van een backend eigenaar token.
nl.List all the payments associated with th: Laat alle betalingen zien die gekoppeld zijn aan de betalingslink. Deze API moet worden aangeroepen met behulp van een backend teken.
nl.Create a new payment. This API must be c: Maak een nieuwe betaling. Deze API moet worden aangeroepen met behulp van een backend teken.
nl.Start the authorization flow for a payme: Start de autorisatiestroom voor een betaling. Deze API kan worden aangeroepen met behulp van de `resource_token` die gekoppeld is aan de betaling of een backend beenaar.
nl.Submit the provider details selected by: Dien de providergegevens in die geselecteerd zijn door de PSU. Deze API kan aangeroepen worden met behulp van de `resource_token` die gekoppeld is aan de betaling of een backend beker token.
nl.Submit the scheme details selected by th: Stuur de schemagegevens in die zijn geselecteerd door de PSU. Deze API kan worden aangeroepen met behulp van de `resource_token` die gekoppeld is aan de betaling of een backend beker token.
nl.Submit form details filled by the PSU. T: Verzend formuliergegevens ingevuld door PSU. Deze API kan aangeroepen worden met behulp van de `resource_token` geassocieerd met de betaling of een backend beach token.
nl.Submit the consent given by the user. Th: Stuur de toestemming door de gebruiker. Deze API kan worden aangeroepen met behulp van de `resource_token` geassocieerd met de betaling of een backend beenaar.
nl.Submit the user account selection option: De optie voor selectie gebruikersaccount indienen door de gebruiker. Deze API kan aangeroepen worden door gebruik te maken van de `resource_token` die gekoppeld is aan de betaling of een backend beach token.
nl.Cancel a payment. This API can be called: Annuleer een betaling. Deze API kan worden aangeroepen met de `resource_token` die gekoppeld is aan de betaling of een backend beker token.
nl.Save the account details associated with: Sla de accountgegevens op die zijn gekoppeld aan een betaling voor latere hergebruik. Deze API kan aangeroepen worden door gebruik te maken van de `resource_token` die gekoppeld is aan de betaling of een backend beach token.
nl.Returns payment details. This API can be: Retourneert betalingsdetails. Deze API kan worden aangeroepen met behulp van de `resource_token` geassocieerd met de betaling of een backend beker token.
nl.Refund a merchant account payment, eithe: Terugbetaling van een handelaarsaccount (geheel of gedeeltelijk).
Retourneert alle terugbetalingen van een betaling.
nl.Returns refund details for a specific pa: Retourneert teruggavedetails van een specifieke betaling.
Geeft een lijst van betalingsaanbieders terug.
nl.Returns payment provider details. This A: Geeft betalingsprovider details terug. Deze API kan worden aangeroepen zonder dat er authenticatie nodig is.
nl.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Maak een aangepaste API call naar een specifiek eindpunt
nl.Optional ID of the user whose mandates y: Optionele ID van de gebruiker wiens mandaten u wilt weergeven.
nl.Optional limit on the number of mandates: Optionele limiet voor het aantal mandaten om terug te sturen.
Het ID van het mandaat om te verkrijgen.
nl.The ID of the mandate to start the autho: Het ID van het mandaat om de autorisatiestroom voor te starten.
nl.The ID of the mandate for which consent: Het ID van het mandaat waarvoor toestemming wordt verleend.
nl.The ID of the mandate for which provider: Het ID van het mandaat waarvoor de selectie van aanbieders wordt ingediend.

ID van het te bevestigen mandaat

nl.The ID of the mandate to retrieve the co: Het ID van het mandaat om de beperkingen voor op te halen.
nl.The ID of the merchant account to be ret: Het ID van het handelaarsaccount dat moet worden opgehaald.
nl.The ID of the merchant account to return: Het ID van de handelaarsaccount om de transacties voor terug te geven.
nl.Timestamp for the start of the range to: Tijdstempel voor het begin van het bereik (inclusief). Gebruikt ISO-8601 formaat van YYYY-MM-DDDH:MM:SS±HMM.
nl.Timestamp for the end of the range to qu: Tijdstempel voor het einde van het bereik (inclusief). Gebruikt ISO-8601 formaat van YYYY-MM-DDDH:MM:SS±HMM.
